story_title: Five private pool villas, above the Ayung River valley.
story_lead: High above the Ayung River Valley, five private pool villas rest along Sayan Ridge, where privacy and quality come first. Each villa is designed as a true home away from home, with attentive butler service, restorative spa treatments, and a restaurant that looks out over the valley's sweeping green.

Butler service and in-villa spa treatments

findings.title: Major OTAs still missing
findings.text: The Ridge is on Booking.com (9.8 from 139 reviews), Expedia, Agoda and Mr & Mrs Smith. Some of the major OTAs where couples look for private pool villas in Ubud are still missing from your distribution.

findings.title: A reputation ahead of its reach
findings.text: A MICHELIN Key and a 9.8 guest rating put The Ridge at the top of Ubud. That reputation only works on the channels where The Ridge is listed: every missing channel is demand that books elsewhere.

findings.title: Months that book late
findings.text: Around Sayan, guests book one-bedroom villas two to three weeks ahead. On 24 November the area had 13% of December and 8% of January on the books: these nights are sold in the last weeks, on the channels where guests are looking.

gap_source: Source: PriceLabs Market Research, one-bedroom villas within 5 km of Sayan (about 2,600 listings), read 24 Nov 2026: market occupancy by month over the last 12 months (booked nights ÷ available nights); annual average 49%. This market averages about IDR 1.3M a night, far below The Ridge: it is a reference for seasonality, not for your rates or your own occupancy.
cta_title: More couples at The Ridge, on the channels you are not on yet.
cta_text: The proposal that comes with this analysis shows how. Fifteen minutes to walk through it with your team: your current channels, rates and operations stay exactly as they are.
